name: buildmapper
description: Building-permit intelligence for suppliers and trades in Canada: scored permits on a map, your pipeline and documents, and customer-list checks against new permits.

interface.longDescription: BuildMapper reads the building permits filed across British Columbia, Alberta and Ontario, names the builder on each, and scores every permit for the user's trade, territory and timing. Connected to ChatGPT, a BuildMapper user can search permits by place, date, type and value and see them on a map; open a project's details; check a customer list they already keep in a spreadsheet or CRM against current permits without importing it; read their pipeline, notes, calendar, watched builders, alerts, quotes, contracts and takeoffs; ask their own product catalog and ERP mirror where connected; and, after confirming, save leads, move stages, add notes, schedule follow-ups, watch builders, and start draft emails, quotes and contracts. It acts as the signed-in user with the same visibility rules as the app and never sends anything on the user's behalf.
defaultPrompt: Show me building permits over $1 million filed in Kelowna in the last 90 days
What's in my BuildMapper pipeline right now?
Which of these customers are building right now: PanoHomes, TKI Construction, Fawdry Homes?

positive.description: Search permits in a city by value and date, shown on the map.
positive.prompt: Show me building permits over $1 million filed in Kelowna in the last 90 days.
positive.expected_behavior: A map and list of Kelowna permits valued at $1M or more filed in the last 90 days, each with its address or area, project type, value, filed date, builder and the user's score, plus the total count.

positive.description: Read the signed-in user's sales pipeline.
positive.prompt: What's in my BuildMapper pipeline right now?
positive.expected_behavior: The demo account's 12 Kelowna leads grouped by stage (New, Contacted, Quoted, Won, Lost), with addresses such as 5950 Lapointe Dr and 4320 Stewart Rd W under Quoted.

positive.description: Check a customer list against current permits without importing it.
positive.prompt: Which of these customers are building right now: PanoHomes, TKI Construction, Fawdry Homes?
positive.expected_behavior: Each of the three companies is reported as matched, with its permit count over the last 12 months and its most recent permits; the reply says nothing was saved.

positive.description: List the user's own sales documents.
positive.prompt: List the quotes and contracts in my BuildMapper documents, with their status.
positive.expected_behavior: Quote Q-1041 to TKI Construction for the framing package at 5950 Lapointe Dr ($193,725 CAD, sent) and contract C-1007 with PanoHomes for 965 Mitchell Rd ($96,200 CAD, signed).

positive.description: Schedule a follow-up after the user confirms the write.
positive.prompt: Schedule a site visit next Tuesday at 10am called "Walk the Lapointe Dr job".
positive.expected_behavior: After the user confirms, the event is created on the BuildMapper calendar and the reply states the title, date and time, and that it can be undone.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Kelowna tomorrow?

negative.description: Do not trigger for applying for a permit; BuildMapper reads filed permits, it does not file them.
negative.prompt: How do I apply for a building permit to put a deck on my house in Kelowna?

negative.description: Do not trigger for commodity prices.
negative.prompt: What is the price of lumber futures this week?

review.commerce_description: BuildMapper does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: permit search with a map, project details, pipeline, documents, saved research, customer-list matching against permits, and pipeline changes the user confirms. Resubmission: tool annotations corrected to match behaviour. Tools that only add a record (a lead, a note, a calendar event, a watch, a draft quote or contract, an imported list) are destructiveHint false; tools that change, delete or revert are true; draft_email, which returns a draft and stores nothing, is read-only; save_company_contact, which writes a shared builder record, is open-world.
